page.overview:
Who is Bel-Hathor?

Bel-Hathor, called Bel-Hathor the Sage, was the tenth High Elven Phoenix King of Ulthuan, and the third to originate from Saphery. He was succeeded by Finubar, the current Phoenix King.

Bel-Hathor is best remembered for banning outsiders, such as the Humans of the Old World, from visiting Ulthuan, erecting great protective barriers across the sea to prevent anyone from approaching.

Bel-Hathor is also known for authoring The History of the Mages of Saphery.

With the suicide of the Phoenix King Morvael, the Asur found themselves leaderless during a time of war against the Druchii. The clear candidate for the Phoenix Throne, Mentheus of Caledor, was dead, and none could agree on a suitable replacement. In the end, Bel-Hathor, a wizard prince of Saphery, was chosen and crowned.
